name: leeward_truth_v1
notes: The coefficients the synthetic world is generated from, in log-odds, keyed by term
name in leeward/model/design.py. Units are that module's: heat per 10F above 82F,
PM2.5 per 50 ug/m3 above 35, outage as the fraction of the ZIP dark, med_thermoreg_score
None of these are measurements. They are the world the simulator generates and the
model is then asked to recover, so they are deliberately NOT the prior means in
leeward/model/priors.py -- a fit that returns its own prior has demonstrated nothing.
Every one carries a source line below: SPEC 5.4 where docs/SPEC.md fixed the number,
and a one-line reason where it did not.
The medication interactions are planted even though every medication column in today's
cohort is zero. cohort/medications.py fills those columns and the terms switch on by
themselves. Plant them now or the model can never recover them.

sources.alpha: SPEC 5.4. 0.2-2%/day off-event for a veteran with no risk factors (SPEC 5.5)
sources.beta_copd: assumption: the main respiratory condition; above the 0.8 prior so a fit has to move
sources.beta_chf: assumption: fluid balance, so it reaches both breathing and heat
sources.beta_diabetes: assumption: thermoregulation and a daily medication schedule
sources.beta_dialysis: assumption: thrice-weekly care on site is the exposure
sources.beta_cancer_tx: assumption: scheduled infusion is the exposure
sources.beta_ptsd: SPEC 6.3 prior is Normal(0.3, 0.3); planted a little above it
sources.delta_heat: SPEC 5.4 delta_heat_lag, per 10F above NYC Health's 82F threshold
sources.eps_pm25: SPEC 5.4 eps_pm25_lag, per 50 ug/m3 above the EPA 24-hour standard
sources.zeta_evac: assumption: an evacuation order moves people; close to the flood term
sources.kappa_outage: SPEC 5.4, per fraction of the ZIP without power
sources.psi_sitedown: SPEC 5.4: every patient of a closed site feels it, not only the site-dependent
sources.theta_heat_x_meds: SPEC 5.4 theta.heat_x_meds, per med_thermoreg_score unit (CDC mechanism weights)
sources.theta_heat_x_raas_diuretic: assumption above the 0.5 prior; CDC names this combination explicitly
sources.theta_heat_x_acb: assumption above the 0.5 prior; ACB >= 3 is the clinical threshold
sources.theta_heat_x_renal_triple: assumption at the 0.6-0.7 prior; NSAID + RAAS + diuretic, AKI with dehydration
sources.theta_heat_x_no_ac: assumption: NYC Health reports no home cooling as the dominant heat-death factor
sources.theta_smoke_x_pact: SPEC 5.4 theta.smoke_x_pact; the PACT Act presumptive list
sources.theta_outage_x_cold_chain: assumption above the 0.9 prior; insulin spoils in about a day
sources.theta_flood_x_lowfloor: SPEC 5.4 theta.flood_x_lowfloor; the Ida basement deaths
sources.theta_sitedown_x_sitedependent: SPEC 5.4 theta.sitedown_x_sitedependent; Sandy dialysis and OTP
sources.theta_sitedown_x_controlled: assumption above the 0.9 prior; retail emergency refill excludes controlled substances
sources.theta_mail_x_supply: assumption above the 1.2 prior; four in five VA prescriptions arrive by mail
